description: Authoritative top-level spawn key spellings for the Rust bus gate. This registry rejects case aliases; it does not accept operations or grant authority. Historical Go snapshot remains unchanged.

reservations.intents: The shared workflow admission normalizer inspects caller intents; reserving spelling does not enable a new spawn operation.
reservations.op: Conservative source closure includes the shared workflow normalizer operation read behind historical_reads=false; this reservation grants no operation.
reservations.projectCwd: The launch coordinator removes this caller key and derives project identity itself.
reservations.targetHub: The local launch coordinator refuses this selector without its complete remote admission adapter.
reservations.workflowReservationToken: The launch coordinator removes this caller key and mints its own workflow admission token.
reservations.autoTitle: Native launch opt-in to hub-owned automatic naming of an unlabelled session; boolean only, grants no authority, and a launch label always wins.

cases.why: Recognized root aliases must fail at the real bus while canonical spellings retain existing provider semantics.
